item.title: Keeping Up With Space Science
item.description: The most underrated category of achievements while working on engineering projects and scientific research is the ability of engineering teams to bring down costs, by either optimising process (which is the easier and faster to achieve), or by redesigning how systems interact with each other. I keep reading optimistic scientific achievements in space technologies, and most of the optimism is covered by the re-usability aspect. Engineering re-usability is not very easy to achieve, hence I wanted to understand, at least on a higher level about the design decision and engineering efforts taken to make rockets reusable.

item.title: Jointly Training Retriever and Language Model
item.description: TLDR Value Generated and Results Key Concepts Understanding Methods Maths Inspiration for real world from ATLAS TLDR Challenges the idea that memorisation, in terms of few-shot learning requires large-scale parameter count. Idea is to separates memorisation of information from reasoning/generalisation capabilities of the LLM. Key concept, that generates value is the joint training of the dense retrival model(model which converts the query and documents to high-dimensional space) and the language model(which has decent reasoning capabilities).

item.title: Anatomy of Memory Utilisation
item.description: To understand, how to train the model efficiently, its very important to understand how the memory is behaving in different training stages. In this blog, we will try to understand the anatomy of memory utilisation while training a model.\ Anatomy of Model Memory while training: Optimizer states Gradients Forward Activation for gradient computation Tempory Buffers Optimizer States: AdamW is primarly used for training models which requires more training cycles and has effectively higher trainable parameter.
